patterns: Year one-liners dominate: first industrial policy = 1948, IPR 1956 = Economic Constitution, licence raj abolished 1991, liberal policy year 1991.
APPSC asks feature questions: IPR 1948 defined public and private spheres; IPR 1956 provisions (licensing, public sector, small industry); 51% FDI only in high-priority industries.
Numbers recur: 18 licensed industries in 1991, 24% equity in SSI, arms and ammunition opened May 2001.
Traps: joint sector attributed to IPR 1956 in PSC keys, while app notes credit Dutt Committee/1970; avoid items that hinge on it.
App MCQs add AP Policy 4.0 targets and DPIIT history beyond PYQ depth, which suits the AP tilt.
